title: Qabre ali asghar
body:
aaj tak masoomiyat ko ro rahi taqdeer hai
karbala mein qabr e asghar seena e shabbir hai
<<DIVIDER>>
kyun jhulaya usko jhoola hai sina ki nok par
koi batlaye hui asghar se kya taqseer hai
karbala mein qabre asghar seena e shabbir hai
aaj tak masoomiyat ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek ke badle mein sheh ne hai bahattar tan diye
khwaab ibrahim ka shabbir di ta'beer hai
karbala mein qabre asghar seena e shabbir hai
aaj tak masoomiyat ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
dekh kar asghar ke tewar kaampta tha hurmala
hoo bahoo aata nazar hyder ki ye tasveer hai
karbala mein qabre asghar seena e shabbir hai
aaj tak masoomiyat ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
aa rahi kul ambiya ki hai sada e marhaba
deen ke aise kaam aaya asghar e baysheer hai
karbala mein qabre asghar seena e shabbir hai
aaj tak masoomiyat ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
muskuraya hai galay pe khaa ke asghar teer ko
bolti karbal mein dekho khoon ki ta'seer hai
karbala mein qabre asghar seena e shabbir hai
aaj tak masoomiyat ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
is liye matam kuna hai khursheed aur sadiq hasan
aaya e fil qurba ki kaisi ye hui tafseer hai
karbala mein qabre asghar seena e shabbir hai
aaj tak masoomiyat ko...
author: Haider Khursheed
